ProspectingAgentRcmdTarget.name: ProspectingAgentRcmdTarget
ProspectingAgentRcmdTarget.description: Represents prospecting information suggested by generative AI.

ExpirationDate.description: The date the recommendation expires, after which the recommendation is automatically deleted.

OwnerId.description: Required. The ID associated with the owner of the AI-generated recommendation. The owner can be an individual user or a list.

Rationale.description: The explanation of why the agent recommended the target contact or lead. The rationale provides context to guide users in their decision making.

Status.description: The status of the AI-generated recommendation.

TargetId.description: Required. The ID associated with the contact or lead recommended by the AI agent.
